headline: PPG announces Industrial Coatings leadership changes
summary: PITTSBURGH, August 03, 2026--PPG (NYSE:PPG) today announced that Justin Epler has been appointed vice president, Industrial Coatings (IC) Americas, effective Aug. 1, 2026. He will report directly to Juliane Hefel, senior vice president, Industrial Coatings and Specialty Products. Epler will succeed Hendekea Azene, who has decided to leave PPG for an outside opportunity.
